headline: COMPLAINTS 💦 to WATER 🏠 WATCHDOG 📈 JUMP 84% 😱
text:
Water customers 🏡 in England 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 and Wales 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 got absolutely COOKED 🍳 this year 📅 with STEEP 🪜 bill hikes 📈 that left everyone 😤 SCREAMING 🗣️ at their taps 🚰!! The number 🔢 of complaints 📞 to the industry watchdog 🛡️ has SKYROCKETED 🚀 by a RECORD 🏆 84% 📊 in just one year 🗓️ driven by pure customer RAGE 😡 and total confusion 🤯 over those rising bills 💸 that feel like getting RAILED 💦 without the happy ending 😏!! Consumer Council for Water 🧪 said this year-on-year INCREASE 📈 was the HIGHEST ⛰️ in its entire 20-year 🕰️ history 📜 and it shows just how DISSATISFIED 😩 many people are with the whole soggy sector 💧!!

Thames Daddy 🏙️ and his South West Water 🏖️ buddies have been hitting households 🏠 with brutal price hikes 🤑 in recent years 🌎 while regulator Ofwat 🚦 gave firms permission 📜 to crank bills up another MASSIVE 36% 📈 between 2025 🗓️ and 2030 🏁!! Total complaints 📋 to the watchdog 🛡️ exploded to 15,115 🔢 in 2025-26 🗓️ from a measly 8,235 📉 the previous year 🕒 meanwhile direct complaints 📞 to the water companies themselves surged 56% 📊 to a whopping 321,347 🧾 which you gotta do first before even reaching the CCW 📣!! Top three subjects 🥇 of these complaints were measured billing 📏 affordability 💰 and billing admin 📑 with Mike Keil 🧔 the chief exec of CCW saying these figures reflect exactly how dissatisfied 😤 folks still are with the state of the entire water sector 🚰!!

Customers are getting IMPATIENT ⏰ to actually see the benefits 🍑 of these higher bills 💸 that companies keep promising will fund vital upgrades 🔧 yet somehow our rivers are still full of sewage 💩!! Water UK 🏛️ which reps all the firms said they totally get that higher bills are never welcome 🚫 but the cash is needed to fund those vital upgrades 🛠️ that will supposedly secure supplies 🔒 support economic growth 📈 and finally stop sewage 🧪 flowing into our rivers 🌊 and seas 🌊!! The CCW 📊 assessed every water company on complaints per 10,000 households 🏘️ served plus how much effort 😩 customers must expend to actually get their complaint resolved 🔄 with Thames Water 🏙️ and South West Water 🏖️ both rated POOR 🥴 on both performance measures 📉!!

David Bird 🐦 retail director at Thames 🏙️ apologised 🙇 to all customers who have not received the service they should expect 😔 saying they know bill clarity 📄 has been a particular source of frustration 😤 which is why they launched a whole programme 🎯 to redesign them so bills are easier to understand 📖!! Average Thames customer bills shot up 31% 📈 back in 2024 🗓️ but this year they only rose a tiny 3.4% 📉 while South West Water 🏖️ admitted there is more to do 🛠️ to improve customer experience 😌 by reducing repeat contacts 🔄 resolving issues on first contact ☎️ and making sure everyone gets clear timely communication 📨!! Portsmouth Water 🏖️ and Bristol Water 🌉 were the only ones scoring GOOD 🏆 on both metrics 📊 keeping their spot at the top of the rankings as the sector's best performers 🥇!!

Last month 📆 Ofwat approved bill increases 📈 for 13 companies 🏭 to meet increased pressures on infrastructure 🏗️ and the environment 🌍 with five of those firms 🌊 including Thames 🏙️ Severn Trent 🏞️ Southern Water 🏝️ Wessex Water 🏜️ and South East Water 🌊 already permitted to hike bills last year in 2024 🗓️!! A spokesperson 🗣️ for industry body Water UK 🏛️ said we understand increasing bills is never welcome 🚫 but the money is needed to fund vital upgrades 🔧 to secure our water supplies 💧 support economic growth 📈 and end sewage entering our rivers 🏞️ and seas 🌊!! They added that 94% of complaints get dealt with at the earliest stage ⏰ without needing further involvement from the consumer body 📋 and the industry remains committed to improving communication 📢 with customers while clearly showing how their money is being used to deliver the improvements everyone expects 🏆!!
